title: Symphony Sketchpad
description: Draw a picture, then hear it. Twenty-one instruments, each one a colour: pick one and draw, and the stroke sounds as you make it, pitched by how high up the canvas your finger is. It is quantised to a major pentatonic, so there are no wrong notes — a scribble still comes out musical. Then press play and a scanline sweeps across everything you have drawn, firing every point it crosses, and the picture becomes the score. Nothing is sampled: each instrument is a small Web Audio graph built on the spot — a filtered sawtooth for the trumpet, bandpassed noise for the cymbals, a sine swept 150 Hz down to 40 in a tenth of a second for the kick drum. Draw in layers and it plays as an ensemble.
